verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's docs describe its own AI features for analyzing data. Dives turn natural-language prompts into interactive dashboards that you refine conversationally and that stay current with your data. Built-in AI Functions provide LLM text analysis and SQL generation. Natural-language analysis is also offered through the remote MCP server, though that runs through an external agent. What is not shown is the product itself generating insights or suggestions unprompted: the evidence is prompt-driven and mostly comes through MCP-connected agents. Missing for 10: proactive or automatic AI insights and suggestions surfaced inside the MotherDuck UI, clear evidence that Dives are authored in-app rather than only via an external agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Generate interactive, shareable dashboards from natural language prompts
you can ask a question and save the answer as a Dive that stays current with your data.
AI Functions: Built-in LLM functions for text analysis, embeddings, and SQL generation
The MotherDuck remote MCP Server lets you analyze your data using natural language and generate interactive visualizations, all without writing SQL.
